grundblock:
Photorealistic fashion character photograph of a fictional adult character, editorial lookbook style. Seamless pure white studio background that fades to a very light grey at the floor, soft large diffused key light with gentle fill, faint soft contact shadow under the feet, no props, no scenery. 85mm lens look, f/8, everything sharp, natural skin texture with real pores, real fabric weave and stitching, true-to-life colors, clean high-end retouching without plastic skin. Vertical 3:4 frame.
Avoid: text, letters, logos, brand names, watermark, celebrity likeness, extra fingers, distorted hands, warped face, cropped head, busy background, cartoon look.
fotoanker: Use the person in the reference image as the identity anchor: keep the same face shape, eye shape and color, nose, lips, skin tone, apparent age and hair texture. Transform only styling, hair design, wardrobe and pose as described below. The result must clearly be the same person.

typen.normal: Realistic everyday proportions, natural features, believable street-casting look, styling turned down one notch.
typen.kuehn: One bold signature feature dominates (hair sculpture or statement garment), confident attitude, still fully realistic.
typen.extrem: Push hair, silhouette, wardrobe volume and posture to a sculptural, almost surreal level, like a high-fashion caricature. Face anatomy stays human, natural and respectful; never exaggerate ethnic features or skin tone.
typen.insekt: Reimagine the character as a premium anthropomorphic insect-human hybrid: glossy chitin plates on skin, slender antennae, subtle compound-eye sheen, an extra pair of small arms folded neatly, human posture, wearing the described outfit. Friendly, charismatic, not scary. photoreal creature design like a high-budget film creature, not a cartoon, not a mascot costume.
typen.frosch: Reimagine the character as a premium anthropomorphic frog: smooth glistening green skin with natural spots, wide friendly mouth, big round eyes set high on the head, webbed fingers, human posture, wearing the described outfit. photoreal creature design like a high-budget film creature, not a cartoon, not a mascot costume.
typen.katze: Reimagine the character as a premium anthropomorphic cat: realistic fur with fine detail, whiskers, expressive ears, tail visible, cat face with human expressiveness, human posture, wearing the described outfit. photoreal creature design like a high-budget film creature, not a cartoon, not a mascot costume.
typen.hund: Reimagine the character as a premium anthropomorphic dog: realistic fur, dog snout and ears, loyal expressive eyes, tail visible, human posture, wearing the described outfit. photoreal creature design like a high-budget film creature, not a cartoon, not a mascot costume.
typen.nager: Reimagine the character as a premium anthropomorphic rodent (pick mouse, rat, hamster, capybara or squirrel to fit the vibe): realistic fur, whiskers, small hands, prominent front teeth, human posture, wearing the described outfit. photoreal creature design like a high-budget film creature, not a cartoon, not a mascot costume.
typen.vogel: Reimagine the character as a premium anthropomorphic bird: realistic layered feathers, beak, bird eyes, feathered wing-arms ending in feathered fingers, human posture, wearing the described outfit. photoreal creature design like a high-budget film creature, not a cartoon, not a mascot costume.
